title: Tidy up Docker
summary: Old containers and volumes pile up. Start one, remove the junk, and keep what matters.

tasks.title: `sleepy` is running again: the same container, not a new one
tasks.hint: A stopped container can be started again with `docker start sleepy`. Don't remove it and run a new one: that would be a different container.

tasks.title: The finished containers `old-1` and `old-2` are removed
tasks.hint: `docker ps -a` shows stopped containers too. Remove them with `docker rm old-1 old-2`.

tasks.title: The volumes `junk-1` and `junk-2` are removed
tasks.hint: `docker volume ls` lists volumes. Remove them with `docker volume rm junk-1 junk-2`.

tasks.title: `keep-me` is still running, and the volume `keep-data` is still there
tasks.hint: Be careful with commands that remove everything at once, like `docker system prune --volumes`. Remove things by name.
